name: toxicity_benchmark-evaluation
description: A suite for evaluating models' propensity to produce toxic, abusive, or harmful language in responses and to detect toxicity in text. It aggregates examples and annotations used to measure both classification performance and safe-response generation across a variety of toxic content types. The benchmark is aimed at safety evaluation and mitigation testing for language models.
evaluation_method: F1 (primary) and accuracy for classification; human_eval for generation where applicable
reputation: Moderately used by safety researchers and practitioners as a practical benchmark for toxicity evaluation, though not a single canonical standard across the community.
